name: .243 Cal-069gr Absolute Hammer™
note: Recommended use: Medium and Big Game Hunting. The product page also says: "This 69gr 1-10″ twist Absolute Hammer™ should be really fun in the 243win. Should be able to get close to 3900 fps with very little recoil. This kind of velocity will give a max point blank range of 430y and still be hitting the target at 2400 fps. Wow!! Look at powders on the fast side of normal. The Absolute Hammer™ will not line up with conventional data and should only be loaded by experience re-loaders that are accustomed reading pressure signs."
